title: Check: Greenhouse Gases and Climate Change (B)

questions.stem: Which of the following is a major source of methane (CH4) emissions?

options.text: Agriculture, including cattle farming and rice paddies

questions.explanation: Agriculture is a major source of methane. Cattle and other livestock produce methane during digestion, and rice paddies produce methane from waterlogged conditions. Methane is also released from landfills and natural gas leaks. Although methane is less abundant than CO2, it is about 25 times more potent as a greenhouse gas.
